thread:
ana: quick report from todays onboarding run: demo using JS SDK + JSON_MODE hit schema failures. zod expected objects but got escaped-json strings inside arrays.

ben: can you paste the minimal raw vs received payload?

ana: raw model output (json-mode):
```json
{"choices":[{"meta":{"id":"c1"},"val":42},{"meta":{"id":"c2"},"val":99}]}
```
what the validator got after sdk sanitizer:
```json
{"choices":["{\\"meta\\":{\\"id\\":\\"c1\\"},\\"val\\":42}","{\\"meta\\":{\\"id\\":\\"c2\\"},\\"val\\":99}"]}
```

samir: ugh, thats the sanitizer collapsing array members to strings. is this only JS?

ana: yes — py sample app unchanged. repro steps in the sample-app branch: github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/gh-2001-array-preserve-repro (small test).

ben: sanity check: JSON_MODE=true + fncall helper path triggers a normalize step that was written to make arbitrary model text safe for downstream code. it assumed arrays contain primitives and stringified objects.

samir: parsing heuristics are dangerous for general text. earlier we had false-positives where prose with { } got parsed.

ana: proposal: add an explicit opt-in config PRESERVE_ARRAY_OBJECTS or SANITIZE_PARSE_ARRAY_STRINGS that only runs when JSON_MODE is true and user opts in. limitations: only parse elements that are strings beginning with '{' or '[' and under size threshold (8k). add telemetry event sanitizer.array_element_parse(success/failed).

ben: +1. For parity, make sure JS and Py SDKs align: py should get the opt-in too so sample parity remains. But keep default conservative (off) to avoid surprises.

samir: add unit tests: mixed arrays (numbers, plain strings, object-strings) and top-level stringified objects should remain strings. Also add an integration test that simulates fncall flow.

qa-bot: running unit tests for branch gh-2001 (job 1123).

ben: opened draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/612 - implements SANITIZE_PARSE_ARRAY_STRINGS env var, size guard, regex check, and telemetry. request review from @samir @ana.

ana: updated onboarding demo docker-compose to set SANITIZE_PARSE_ARRAY_STRINGS=true so new users won't hit the friction. added note in onboarding/README about tradeoffs and how to opt-out.

samir: minor nit in PR: ensure we only attempt JSON.parse when the string is not obviously natural language. Suggest requiring trimmed string to start with '{' or '[' and parse result to be object/array. Also avoid parsing if parse timeouts or throws.

ben: implemented the safety checks and added a small timeout wrapper around parse (fastfail after 50ms). added telemetry for parsing time and outcome.

eng-bot: CI passed for PR 612 (job 1123) :white_check_mark:. release candidate scheduled (release/0.11.0-rc).

ana: thanks all. follow-up: we'll collect telemetry for 14 days, then revisit flipping default. opened issue #3301 to track roll-forward decision.

samir: adding a short note to the SDK changelog and the migration guide so integrators know this opt-in exists.

ana: closing thread; onboarding demo now passes. :party-parrot:
